newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas holds Australian market lead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas holds Australian market lead.

text.p: Australia's Qantas Airways Ltd maintained its market lead in the country's domestic aviation market in the year to June 30, 1996, official Department of Transport figures released on Monday show.
Qantas holds 53 percent of the market, measured by revenue passenger kilometres (RPK), compared with Ansett Australia's 47 percent, the figures showed.
The department said total revenue passenger kilometres (RPK) increased 7.3 percent to 27.1 billion RPKs in 1995/96 from 25.3 billion RPKs in 1994/95.
"These results are a steady indication of the steady growth in domestic aviation," the department said in a statement.
Total passenger numbers increased to 24.8 million from 23.4 million, the department said.
But load factors remained almost steady at 72.4 percent from 72.5 percent in 1994/95.
Qantas executive general manager for commercial operations Geoff Dixon welcomed the result.
Figures for June showed RPKs increased 8.7 percent over June, 1995, to 2.2 billion RPKS, with Qantas recording 1.5 billion and Ansett 1.0 billion.
Ansett is 50 percent owned by News Corp Ltd, while TNT Ltd is in the process of selling its 50 percent stake to Air New Zealand
